claims.text: Fine-grained semantic types are used in entity typing to assign multiple types to an entity based on its context.
The task of fine-grained entity typing is approached as a multi-label classification problem, allowing entities to have multiple types.
Recent work has moved towards finer-grained semantic types with richer ontologies to improve performance in natural language tasks.
